correctness.rationale: Uniform iid occupancy decomposition gives conditional T|B geometric product for each 2<=b<=n, with B=n+1/T=n treated separately. One common geometric construction proves strict conditional stochastic order; prefix unit-wait indicators give exact covariance with every summand negative. Gaussian survival bound yields moment-uniform Rayleigh convergence and a rigorous L2 regression approximation; harmonic/geometric variance identities yield exact asymptotic covariance and Pearson constant. The included standalone script exhaustively enumerated 873611 prefixes and checked 60 exact-rational moments, which are corroboration rather than infinite proof.

value.rationale: The first duplicate and final completion are classical paired stopping times on a common sample; a full conditional dependence law is more informative than separate marginal Rayleigh/Gumbel laws. Strict stochastic order identifies an exact negative regression principle for all thresholds. The nonconstant Rayleigh-square conditional mean and sharp covariance/correlation rates provide a natural scale for joint sampling variability without arbitrary slices or insignificant coefficient changes.
